[[Choose Your Secondary Profession (Factions quest)]] (if Mesmer not primary profession) | profession = Mesmer | primary = y | secondary = n }} Having completed fundamental Mesmer training, meet with [[Master Togo]] for further instructions. ==Quest information== ===Requirements=== {{ Standard prerequisites | campaign = factions | profession = Mesmer | primary = y | secondary = n }} ===Objectives=== * Return to the monastery. * Seek out Master Togo in Linnok Courtyard. ===Reward=== * 600 [[Experience]] * 50 [[Gold]] ==Walkthrough== Open your [[World Map]] (default: "M"), and click on [[Shing Jea Monastery]]. Select travel. Now exit to the east, into [[Linnok Courtyard]]. Master Togo can be found in the middle of it. ==Dialogue== ===Initial dialogue=== ;Lo Sha :''I must take this gift on to Mei Ling, so I will send you back to the monastery now. Meet with '''Master Togo''' in '''Linnok Courtyard'''.'' :''It is a long way back to the monastery, but you can travel there easily enough using your map.'' {{ Offer dialog | accept = I'm on my way. | decline = I need to rest, first. | ask = You are ready to become a Mesmer, . Use your map to return to the monastery. '''Master Togo''' awaits you in '''Linnok Courtyard'''. }} ===Reward dialogue=== ;Master Togo :''Headmaster Kaa has told me great thing about you, . You have begun to learn the way of the Mesmer, but to reach your full potential you must choose a second path.'' :'' Speak with the other headmasters and learn what they have to teach you. When you are ready to make a final choice, come and speak to me again.'' {{sic}} ==Notes== *The reward for this quest can be received eight times by one character. Once for each profession. The first time will be a primary quest for your profession, whatever that may be. The other seven times are simply a matter of talking to every profession's Headmaster before choosing your second profession. Completing their quests, as well as the quests given by the characters you are sent to in these quests, will put this in your quest log eventually.
